paragraphs: Rabbi Binyamin bar Levi: [Jerusalem Talmud, Pe’ah, beginning of chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Peah.1.1).
Hugras ben Levi (in the time of the Temple): [Yoma, chapter 3, mishnah 11](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Yoma.3.11).
The well-known Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.
Salman ben Levi: [Jerusalem Talmud, Kilayim, chapter 1, halakhah 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Kilayim.1.4).[^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Ketubot 56b for Abba bar Levi; that name is absent from the linked text.
The Jerusalem Talmud passage reads “Salman bar Levi”; Hyman has “Salman ben Levi.” Both ben and bar mean “son of.”
